risks.risk: Brake condition (pads/rotors/drums) and whether brakes work safely
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of both bikes: squeeze brake levers while stationary and show wheels stopping quickly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not confirmed (assume needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Gear/shifter and drivetrain condition (chain wear, skipping gears, rust)
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the chain + cassette/gear area and a video riding slowly showing gear changes without skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drivetrain may need cleaning/lubrication/adjustment.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment and tire health (sidewall cracks, low tread, wobble)
risks.proof: Ask for a video spinning each front wheel and a close-up of tire sidewalls and tread.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tires may be worn (possible replacement cost).

risks.risk: Frame/fork damage or bent wheels not visible in this angle
risks.proof: Ask for straight-on photos of both wheels and fork from front and side, plus a quick wobble check video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no damage confirmed (assume worst-case minor repairs possible).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (bell, reflectors, lights, baskets) or loose components
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo: handlebars, brakes, lights, reflectors, pedals, and basket attachment points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as accessories may be incomplete or need tightening.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of: brakes (front+rear), chain, gear shifters, and both tires (tread + sidewalls).
Send a short video for each bike: stationary brake test + slow ride showing gear changes (if any).
Send photos of the frame/seatpost area showing any brand/model markings (if present).
Confirm whether both bikes have working lights (front) and whether any parts are missing.
response.reason: The photo confirms there are two bicycles, but key condition factors that determine resale value (brakes, drivetrain/gear function, tire/wheel health, and any damage) are not verifiable from this single image. Request the brake/drivetrain/tire proof before pricing.
